scientific_integrity: An analytic minimum-cube decomposition and exact triangular-difference integrals supply the infinite theorem. A separate lattice-point Ehrhart calculation checks four small dimensions. No external independent assessment is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Volumes are in anchored lattice vertex-potential coordinates, not orthonormal zero-sum Euclidean coordinates. The formula is proved for each integer \(n\ge2\); finite Ehrhart checks use \(n=2,3,4,5\) only. An equivalent unindexed earlier calculation remains possible.
title: Exact polynomial-scale volumes of two-row rook-graph Lipschitz dual balls
